question: In each league, considering all seasons, which single team has the fewest total match wins based on comparing home and away goals, including teams with zero wins, ensuring that if multiple teams tie for the fewest wins, only one team is returned for each league?
sql:
-- Final query with integer cast for total_wins
WITH home_wins AS (
    SELECT 
        m.league_id,
        m.home_team_api_id as team_api_id,
        SUM(CASE WHEN m.home_team_goal > m.away_team_goal THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as wins
    FROM Match m
    GROUP BY m.league_id, m.home_team_api_id
),
away_wins AS (
    SELECT 
        m.league_id,
        m.away_team_api_id as team_api_id,
        SUM(CASE WHEN m.away_team_goal > m.home_team_goal THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as wins
    FROM Match m
    GROUP BY m.league_id, m.away_team_api_id
),
team_wins AS (
    SELECT 
        l.id as league_id,
        l.name as league_name,
        t.team_api_id,
        t.team_long_name,
        COALESCE(h.wins, 0) + COALESCE(a.wins, 0) as total_wins
    FROM (
        SELECT DISTINCT league_id, home_team_api_id as team_api_id FROM Match
        UNION
        SELECT DISTINCT league_id, away_team_api_id as team_api_id FROM Match
    ) teams
    JOIN League l ON teams.league_id = l.id
    JOIN Team t ON teams.team_api_id = t.team_api_id
    LEFT JOIN home_wins h ON teams.league_id = h.league_id AND teams.team_api_id = h.team_api_id
    LEFT JOIN away_wins a ON teams.league_id = a.league_id AND teams.team_api_id = a.team_api_id
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT 
        league_id,
        league_name,
        team_api_id,
        team_long_name,
        CAST(total_wins AS INTEGER) as total_wins,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY league_id ORDER BY total_wins ASC, team_api_id ASC) as rn
    FROM team_wins
)
SELECT 
    league_id,
    league_name,
    team_api_id,
    team_long_name,
    total_wins
FROM ranked
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY league_id
